sources.title: GPU cloud pricing
sources.notes: Observed USD 3.99 per H100 SXM GPU-hour for an 8-GPU instance; first-come capacity, not a Finland large-cluster quote. Published 256-GPU cluster comparison rate USD 5.54; taxes extra.

sources.title: DGX H100 deployment planning
sources.notes: DGX H100 reference system: eight GPUs, maximum system power 10.2 kW. Architecture benchmark only; selected liquid-cooled hardware, prices and workload equivalence are unverified.

sources.title: Energy prices
sources.notes: Official consumer-category electricity price statistics. No site-specific tariff has been retrieved; EUR 0.10/kWh is a planning assumption, not a value attributed to this source.

sources.title: LUMI service and academic access
sources.notes: Eligible academic use may be free of charge under CSC policy, through a user account and allocated project. Availability, suitability and sufficient allocation for this consortium remain unknown.

sources.title: Seasons in Finland
sources.notes: Strong seasonal variation requires both winter freeze protection and summer cooling assessment. National climate context does not establish design weather at the proposed site.

sources.title: Climate of Singapore
sources.notes: Equatorial climate has high temperatures and humidity throughout the year. Climate implies different cooling constraints; it does not determine a facility PUE.

sources.title: Connection authorization for projects of 5 MW and above
sources.notes: New projects and additions of 5 MW or more need government authorization before connection. Economic, environmental, social and grid effects are assessed. No authorization is established for this proposal.

sources.title: Our energy
sources.notes: Hydro-Québec describes annual electricity generation as over 99% renewable. This is a utility statement, not a national Canadian statistic or proof of hourly site supply; environmental attributes need separate verification.

sources.title: Green Data Centre Roadmap
sources.notes: Roadmap targets at least 300 MW additional capacity in the near term. This is a policy ambition, not spare capacity available to this project. Source summary reviewed; full page content is limited by website access.

sources.title: Canadian Climate Normals
sources.notes: 1991–2020 station normals are available. A precise Québec site/station has not been selected; design temperatures remain NULL pending selection and hourly extreme-weather review.

design_claims.claim_text: Planning demand is 25% of full-fleet available GPU-equivalent hours, with 97% scheduling availability. It is not a signed university commitment. Training 60%, teaching 25%, inference 15% are workload-mix assumptions.
Compare full 20 MW IT build (year 3), lease from year 1, and conditional 8 MW IT hybrid opening year 4. Lease all unmet demand so every option delivers equal productive hours over years 1–10.

Financial inputs are constant 2026 EUR planning assumptions. Site grid quote, hardware quote, university commitments, water volume and site-specific emissions remain unknown; no missing measurement is entered as zero.

Member institutions retain ownership of their data. A consortium nonprofit would own facility/common infrastructure if approved, with capped member reservations, protected teaching allocations and audited usage-based charges.
